$description: Text styles for the OFFDESK dark theme, identical to typography.offdesk.json, since the build reads one file per theme. Change both together. Each style here replaces the shared style of the same name inside that theme's CSS block, and every shared style is replaced. Family, weight and letter spacing are OFFDESK's: Archivo for everything, IBM Plex Mono for labels, captions and code, from OFFDESK's brand stylesheet (brand/AGENTS/design-md/assets/ofd-brand.css, 5 Nov 2026). Size and line height are Tenon's own, aliasing the same primitives as the shared style, so the theme sits at Tenon's density for app screens. The brand's page sizes (17px body, 32px headings) stay in OFFDESK's stylesheet. Letter spacings are literal ems where the brand sets one, and the 800 and 900 weights are literal because Tenon's weight scale stops at 700. Two things the brand sets are left out because a text style has no part for them: the width axis (125 for display and stat values) and the capitals on mono labels. Archivo and Plex Mono load from dist/tenon-fonts-offdesk.css, which a consumer links itself.

title.$description: Family, weight and letter spacing from the brand's title role (ofd-title), Archivo 800 at -0.01em, taken over the display role, whose width 125 a text style cannot carry. Size and line height from the shared title.

stat.$description: Family, weight and letter spacing from the brand's stat value (ofd-stat-value), Archivo 900 at -0.02em, without its width 125, which a text style cannot carry. Size and line height from the shared stat.

heading-1.$description: Family, weight and letter spacing from the brand's heading-l, Archivo 800 at -0.01em. Size and line height from the shared heading-1.

heading-2.$description: Family, weight and letter spacing from the brand's heading role, Archivo 800 at -0.01em. Size and line height from the shared heading-2.

heading-3.$description: Family, weight and letter spacing from the brand's heading-m, the subhead role, Archivo 600. Size and line height from the shared heading-3.

heading-4.$description: Family, weight and letter spacing from the brand's subhead role, Archivo 600. Size and line height from the shared heading-4.

heading-5.$description: Family, weight and letter spacing from the brand's field label, Archivo 600. Size and line height from the shared heading-5.

heading-6.$description: Family, weight and letter spacing from the brand's mono label (ofd-label), IBM Plex Mono 400 at 0.1em. The brand sets it in capitals, which a text style cannot carry. Size and line height from the shared heading-6.

body.$description: Family, weight and letter spacing from the brand's body, Archivo 400. Size and line height from the shared body.

body-sm.$description: Family, weight and letter spacing from the brand's compact text, Archivo 400. Size and line height from the shared body-sm.

label.$description: Family, weight and letter spacing from the brand's button and field label, Archivo 600. Tenon's label sets buttons, fields and menus, which the brand sets in Archivo, so this is not the mono label, which is heading-6 and caption-sm. Size and line height from the shared label.

caption.$description: Family, weight and letter spacing from the brand's caption, IBM Plex Mono 400, sentence case. Size and line height from the shared caption.

caption-sm.$description: Family, weight and letter spacing from the brand's mono label as used for metadata and tags (ofd-meta-item, ofd-tag), IBM Plex Mono 400 at 0.1em. Its capitals are left out, as for heading-6. Size and line height from the shared caption-sm.

code.$description: Family, weight and letter spacing from the brand's inline mono, IBM Plex Mono 400. Size and line height from the shared code.
